name: Music3AI
tagline: Music3AI is the first web app built exclusively around MiniMax Music 3
description: Music3AI is the first web app built exclusively around MiniMax Music 3. Type lyrics with [Verse]/[Chorus]/[Bridge] section tags, pick a genre, set BPM, key, and vocal timbre, and get a complete structured song you can play and download as WAV or MP3. Free trials included with no signup required; pay-per-song credit packs after that.
